name.en-US: The Most Holy Name of Mary

prayerExcerpt.en-US: All generations will call me blessed, because God has looked upon his lowly handmaid.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Desde agora as gerações hão de chamar-me de bendita pois ele viu a pequenez de sua serva.

meta.face: Our Lady as in recurring-figures.md: a young woman of about eighteen with a delicate, softly OVAL face — a smooth high forehead, a fine straight nose with a narrow bridge, almond-shaped brown eyes under gently arched light-brown brows, softly rounded cheeks, a small rosy mouth, a small rounded chin; light-brown hair parted in the centre, under a white inner veil and blue mantle drawn over the head; she looks down toward the ship with a calm, protective gaze.
meta.basis: St. Jerome's reading of her name as stella maris and St. Bernard's homily 'Respice stellam, voca Mariam' (Super Missus est II, 17) give the feast its traditional image: Mary as the star over a stormy sea. It avoids the monogram, and Our Lady keeps the set's face.
